description: Legal knowledge sources for the RAG conditions (C2, C3). Official English text as published in the Official Journal of the European Union (original version, not consolidated).
version_note: The originally published 2011 versions are used deliberately. The consolidated versions, which include later amendments (e.g. Directive (EU) 2019/2161 amending the Consumer Rights Directive), were deliberately not used.
download_method: curl from the Publications Office CELLAR repository (the official store behind EUR-Lex), requesting the English XHTML by CELEX number with headers 'Accept: application/xhtml+xml' and 'Accept-Language: eng'. The EUR-Lex /TXT/HTML/ pages could not be used because they answer automated requests with an AWS WAF browser challenge and an empty body.
